hooks.prompt: Check if this is a feature branch (not main/master). If so, check if PLAN.md exists at .claude/pdd/{branch}/PLAN.md (or $PDD_WORKSPACE_DIR/{branch}/PLAN.md if set). If PLAN exists, briefly summarize its goal and current tasks. If no PLAN exists, briefly note that /pdd:plan is available for planning.
Context is about to be compacted. If significant discoveries, decisions, or progress were made in this session, suggest running /pdd:notes to preserve them before context is lost.
